title: VVote
tagline: VVote, the decentralised voting system that returns power to the people, you can say goodbye to manipulated elections and hello to transparent democracy. 🗳️💪
description:
Are you sick of corrupt politicians and shady elections? Greetings from vvote! It's similar to Uber, except instead of getting a ride, you get to exercise your right to vote for your preferred candidates. It is also quick, convenient, and simple to use, much like Uber.

The best thing is that vvote is backed by blockchain technology, making your vote very safe and impervious to manipulation. A network of nodes distributes the power, so you know your voice is being heard clearly and there is no corrupt intermediary to worry about.

So why are you still waiting? Become a part of the vvote movement and aid in creating a more open and democratic society one vote at a time! 🗳️💪
how_its_made:
Our project is built on a tech stack that includes Javascript and Solidity. Javascript is used for the frontend, while Solidity is used for the smart contract that runs on the blockchain. We chose these languages because of their popularity and the large community of developers.

To deploy our project, we used Vercel, a serverless deployment platform that made it easy to deploy both the frontend and backend code. Vercel also provides automatic scaling and built-in CDN, making our application fast and reliable.

For testing, we used the Goerli chain, a public Ethereum test network. This allowed us to test the smart contract securely and ensure that it works as intended before deploying it to the mainnet.
